mutation_condition_isolated: Runs the engine in a copy of the component inside the run folder: nothing is written in the workspace. It mutates the copy and re-runs the project's tests (project code executes).
mutation_condition_stryker: StrykerJS with the JSON report; scope: {scope}.
mutation_condition_mutmut: mutmut 3 with the statistics export; scope: {scope}.
mutation_limitation_executes: Mutation testing executes project code: the component's tests run once per mutant.
mutation_limitation_bounded: The run is bounded by the timeoutSeconds of the instance; a run that exceeds it has no score.
mutation_no_engine: Cannot tell which mutation engine the component {dir} uses. Set engine: stryker, engine: mutmut or engine: stryker-net on the instance.
mutation_stryker_missing: StrykerJS is not in the JGates tools image ({detail}). Download the tools of this JGates version (jgates setup); JGates never installs a tool on your machine.
mutation_stryker_no_version: The StrykerJS found at {detail} did not tell its version.
mutation_python_missing: There is no Python to run mutmut ({detail}). Set JGATES_PYTHON or put the project's Python on the PATH.
mutation_mutmut_missing: mutmut is not installed in Python {python}. Install it in the project's environment (pip install mutmut); JGates installs nothing during a run.
mutation_mutmut_windows: mutmut {version} forks worker processes and does not run natively on Windows. Run the mutation stage on Linux, macOS or WSL; nothing was proven here.
mutation_blocked: The mutation engine could not run: {detail}
mutation_no_invocation: The plan has no mutation invocation for the instance {tool}.
mutation_copy_failed: The component could not be copied into the run folder: {detail}
mutation_timeout: Mutation testing exceeded the limit of {seconds} s and was ended; there is no score.
mutation_cancelled: The run was cancelled; the engine was stopped and its partial output was kept in the logs.
mutation_no_report: The engine produced no readable result (code {code}): {detail}
mutation_exit_error: The mutation engine ended with code {code}: {detail}
mutation_invalid_output: The mutation result could not be interpreted: {detail}
mutation_no_mutants: The engine produced no mutant to judge (nothing in scope, or every mutant was excluded): no score was measured.
mutation_survived: {file}:{line}: mutant {mutator} survived ({replacement}); no test fails when the code is changed this way.
mutation_not_covered: {file}:{line}: mutant {mutator} is not covered ({replacement}); no test reaches this code.
mutation_below: The mutation score of the component {component} is {score}% ({detected} of {valid} mutants detected), below the minimum of {minimum}% ({source}).
mutation_reason: {engine} {version}: mutation score {score}% ({detected} of {valid} mutants detected), {survived} survived, {notCovered} not covered
mutation_reason_minimum: {engine} {version}: mutation score {score}% ({detected} of {valid} mutants detected), {survived} survived, {notCovered} not covered; minimum {minimum}%
mutation_truncated: {listed} of {total} surviving mutants are listed as findings
mutation_exclusion_invalid: {count, plural, one {# mutant was left out of the score (did not compile, crashed, ignored or skipped)} other {# mutants were left out of the score (did not compile, crashed, ignored or skipped)}}
mutation_setting_engine: The engine of the instance {tool} is {value}; use one of: {allowed}.
mutation_setting_mutate: The mutate setting of the instance {tool} must be a list of relative patterns without commas, leading dashes or '..'.
mutation_setting_minimum: The minimumScore of the instance {tool} is {value}; use a number from 0 to 100.
mutation_condition_timeout: Bounded to {seconds} s; a run that exceeds it has no score.
mutation_mutmut_not_in_image: mutmut is not in the JGates tools image ({detail}). Download the tools of this JGates version (jgates setup); JGates never installs a tool on your machine.
mutation_condition_stryker_net: Stryker.NET with the JSON report, over the solution (or the one test project) of the copy; scope: {scope}.
mutation_stryker_net_missing: Stryker.NET (dotnet-stryker) is not in the JGates tools image ({detail}). Download the tools of this JGates version (jgates setup); JGates never installs a tool on your machine.
mutation_stryker_net_no_target: Stryker.NET needs a solution (*.sln, *.slnx) or one test project referencing Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk in the component {dir}.
